papers.title: Automatised selection of load paths to construct reduced-order models in computational damage micromechanics: from dissipation-driven random selection to Bayesian optimization
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present new reliable model order reduction strategies for computational micromechanics. The difficulties rely mainly upon the high dimensionality of the parameter space represented by any load path applied onto the representative volume element. We take special care of the challenge of selecting an exhaustive snapshot set. This is treated by first using a random sampling of energy dissipating load paths and then in a more advanced way using Bayesian optimization associated with an interlocked division of the parameter space. Results show that we can insure the selection of an exhaustive snapshot set from which a reliable reduced-order model can be built.

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of selecting exhaustive snapshot sets for reduced-order models in computational micromechanics under high-dimensional load paths.
summary_en.method: A two-stage approach combining random sampling of energy-dissipating load paths with Bayesian optimization and interlocked parameter space partitioning.
summary_en.result: Bayesian optimization ensures selection of an exhaustive snapshot set enabling construction of reliable reduced-order models.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical micromechanics simulations demonstrating snapshot set completeness and ROM accuracy.

papers.title: Influencing Factors for the Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Micro Porous Titanium Manufactured by Metal Injection Molding
papers.abstract: Porous titanium is a new structural and functional material. It is widely used in many fields since it integrates the properties of biomaterials with those of metallic foam. A new technology that combines both the preparation and forming of porous materials has been proposed in this paper. Moreover, a new solder was developed that could be employed in the joining of porous materials. Influencing factors for microstructure and mechanical properties of the parent material and joint interface are identified. Metal injection molding (MIM) technology was used for fabricating porous materials. The feedstock for injection molding of porous titanium powders was prepared from titanium powders and a polymer-based binder system. In addition, the proportion of powder loading and binders was optimized. Through MIM technology, a porous titanium filter cartridge was prepared. For the purpose of investigating the thermal debinding technology of the filter cartridge, effects of the sintering temperature on the porosity, morphology of micropores and mechanical properties were analyzed. It could be found that when the sintering temperature increased, the relative density, bending and compression strength of the components also increased. Moreover, the porosity reached 32.28% when the sintering temperature was 1000 °C. The microstructure morphology indicated that micropores connected with each other. Meanwhile, the strength of the components was relatively high, i.e., the bending and compression strength was 65 and 60 MPa, respectively. By investigating the joining technology of porous filter cartridges, the ideal components of the solder and pressure were determined. Further research revealed that the micropore structure of the joint interface is the same as that of the parent material, and that the bending strength of the joint interface is 40 MPa.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多孔钛的制备和力学性能，但未涉及应力遮挡匹配、LPBF制造或疲劳测试，与用户研究方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses metal injection molding (MIM) instead of LPBF, does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究金属注射成型多孔钛的微观结构和力学性能影响因素。
summary_zh.method: 采用金属注射成型技术制备多孔钛，优化粉末装载和粘结剂比例，并研究烧结温度影响。
summary_zh.result: 烧结温度升高提高相对密度和强度，1000°C时孔隙率32.28%，弯曲强度65 MPa，压缩强度60 MPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过弯曲和压缩力学测试验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the factors influencing the microstructure and mechanical properties of porous titanium fabricated by metal injection molding.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium was fabricated using metal injection molding with optimized powder loading and binder system, and the effects of sintering temperature were analyzed.
summary_en.result: Increasing sintering temperature improved relative density and strength; at 1000°C, porosity reached 32.28% with bending and compression strengths of 65 MPa and 60 MPa, respectively.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (bending and compression) was performed to validate the properties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化和敏感性分析应用于火山柱模型，与生物力学或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies UQ to a geophysical volcanic plume model, with no connection to biomedical FEA, implant mechanics, or surrogate modeling for structural design.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化火山柱模型中的参数不确定性对喷发柱高度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用多项式混沌展开和Sobol'指数对PLUME-MoM模型进行全局敏感性分析。
summary_zh.result: 识别出对柱高度影响最大的关键参数，并量化了预测的不确定性范围。
summary_zh.validation: 通过对比文献中的观测数据验证模型预测的合理性。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the impact of parametric uncertainty on the predictions of volcanic plume height using an integral model.
summary_en.method: Polynomial chaos expansion and Sobol' indices are employed for global sensitivity analysis of the PLUME-MoM model.
summary_en.result: Key parameters driving plume height variability are identified, and predictive uncertainty bounds are quantified.
summary_en.validation: Model predictions are validated against observational data from the literature.

papers.title: Institutional and sociopolitical factors in supporting clinical translation: the case of biomedical implant research in Hannover, Germany
papers.abstract: Abstract Clinical translation denotes a focused and rapid process of transferring scientific knowledge into clinical practice and patient care. As a new model of innovation it has gained importance in the biomedical research in recent years. To identify the current state of clinical translation within the routines of hospital based research, we examine structures of the interdisciplinary research consortium BIOFABRICATION in Hannover (Germany) with regard to translational strategies. Moreover, we illustrate general requirements and infrastructural conditions, which are essential to establish a top-level translation center. Consequently, a translational training programme, standardized processes for documentation as well as a platform to support the communication between translational stakeholders were introduced. As an outlook the framework conditions will be evaluated on translational efficiency. The acquired knowledge will be a first step to develop a guideline for an optimized clinical translation of life science research results. It can be finally used as a role model for the planning and optimization of other translational centers.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论的是生物制造研究中的临床转化策略和制度因素，不涉及AI或生物打印技术本身。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation, and does not address autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析生物制造研究中的临床转化现状和制度因素。
summary_zh.method: 通过案例研究考察汉诺威BIOFABRICATION联盟的转化策略。
summary_zh.result: 提出了培训计划、标准化文档和沟通平台等支持措施。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅框架性评估。

summary_en.motivation: To identify the current state of clinical translation within hospital-based biomedical research and the institutional factors that support it.
summary_en.method: A case study of the BIOFABRICATION consortium in Hannover, examining translational strategies and infrastructural conditions.
summary_en.result: Introduced a translational training program, standardized documentation processes, and a communication platform to support stakeholders.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; only a framework for evaluating translational efficiency is proposed.
